style_prefix: Richly textured high-fantasy industrial storybook illustration, precise ink under layered gouache and restrained watercolor, monumental carved stone, weathered brass and iron, pale living mineral growth, amber work lamps against blue-white mana, readable silhouettes, humane faces, numinous wonder inside practical civic machinery.

prompts.prompt: Wide empty rectangular underground gate chamber: west stone stair, central waist-high rune table, east iron grate with low return slot over black brine, pale ribbed calcite gills overhead, old municipal pipe on south wall, newer extraction conduit and polished brass plate on the northeast wall.

South municipal pipe roars with blue-white mana as dwarf priest grips an exposed redirected command lead; older pump Master watches the restored gauge, goblin leaves toward west stair, assessor writes beneath north plate, fractured fourth calcite branch and blackened gill edges show the cost.
